39: public class SneakyThrowsRemover implements PostCompilerTransformation {
40: 	
41: 	@Override public byte[] applyTransformations(byte[] original, String fileName, final DiagnosticsReceiver diagnostics) {
42: 		byte magic0 = original[0];
43: 		byte magic1 = original[1];
44: 		byte magic2 = original[2];
45: 		byte magic3 = original[3];
46: 		int magicHigh = (magic0 & 0xFF) << 8 | (magic1 & 0xFF);
47: 		int magicLow = (magic2 & 0xFF) << 8 | (magic3 & 0xFF);
48: 		int magic = (magicHigh << 16) | magicLow;
49: 		if (magic != 0xCAFEBABE) {
50: 			return null;
51: 		}
52: 
53: 		ClassFileMetaData metadata = new ClassFileMetaData(original);
54: 		String targetOwner = "lombok/Lombok";
55: 		String targetName = "sneakyThrow";
56: 		int poolCountHigh = original[8] & 0xFF;
57: 		int poolCountLow = original[9] & 0xFF;
58: 		int poolSize = (poolCountHigh << 8) | poolCountLow;
59: 		int ownerUtf = -1;
60: 		int nameUtf = -1;
61: 		int ownerClass = -1;
62: 		for (int i = 1; i < poolSize; i++) {
63: 			String utf = metadata.getUtf8Entry(i);
64: 			if (targetOwner.equals(utf)) {
65: 				ownerUtf = i;
66: 			}
67: 			if (targetName.equals(utf)) {
68: 				nameUtf = i;
69: 			}
70: 		}
71: 		if (ownerUtf < 0) {
72: 			return null;
73: 		}
74: 		if (nameUtf < 0) {
75: 			return null;
76: 		}
77: 		for (int i = 1; i < poolSize; i++) {
78: 			byte type = metadata.getType(i);
79: 			if (type == 7) {
80: 				int offset = metadata.getOffset(i);
81: 				int nameIndex = metadata.readValue(offset);
82: 				if (nameIndex == ownerUtf) {
83: 					ownerClass = i;
84: 					break;
85: 				}
86: 			}
87: 		}
88: 		if (ownerClass < 0) {
89: 			return null;
90: 		}
91: 		boolean foundSneakyThrow = false;
92: 		for (int i = 1; i < poolSize; i++) {
93: 			int entryOffset = metadata.getOffset(i);
94: 			int methodOwner = metadata.readValue(entryOffset);
95: 			boolean methodRef = metadata.isMethod(i);
96: 			if (methodRef && methodOwner == ownerClass) {
97: 				int nameAndType = metadata.readValue(entryOffset + 2);
98: 				if (nameAndType > 0 && nameAndType < poolSize) {
99: 					int nameAndTypeOffset = metadata.getOffset(nameAndType);
100: 					int methodNameIndex = metadata.readValue(nameAndTypeOffset);
101: 					int methodDescIndex = metadata.readValue(nameAndTypeOffset + 2);
102: 					if (methodNameIndex == nameUtf) {
103: 						foundSneakyThrow = true;
104: 						break;
105: 					}
106: 				}
107: 			}
108: 		}
109: 		if (!foundSneakyThrow) {
110: 			return null;
111: 		}

113: 		byte[] sourceBytes = original;
114: 		ClassReader jsrReader = new ClassReader(sourceBytes);
115: 		ClassWriter jsrWriter = AsmUtil.classWriterFor(jsrReader);
116: 		ClassVisitor jsrVisitor = AsmUtil.jsrInliningVisitor(jsrWriter);
117: 		int jsrAcceptFlags = 0;
118: 		jsrReader.accept(jsrVisitor, jsrAcceptFlags);
119: 		byte[] inlinedBytes = jsrWriter.toByteArray();
120: 		byte[] fixedByteCode = inlinedBytes;
121: 
122: 		ClassReader reader = new ClassReader(fixedByteCode);
123: 		ClassWriter writer = new ClassWriter(reader, 0);
124:

126:

129: 				return new SneakyThrowsRemoverVisitor(super.visitMethod(access, name, desc, signature, exceptions), diagnostics, changesMade);
130: 			}
131: 		}, 0);
132: 		return changesMade.get() ? writer.toByteArray() : null;
133: 	}

135: 	private static class SneakyThrowsRemoverVisitor extends MethodVisitor {
136: 		private final DiagnosticsReceiver diagnostics;
137: 		private final AtomicBoolean changesMade;
138: 
139: 		SneakyThrowsRemoverVisitor(MethodVisitor mv, DiagnosticsReceiver diagnostics, AtomicBoolean changesMade) {
140: 			super(Opcodes.ASM9, mv);
141: 			this.diagnostics = diagnostics;
142: 			this.changesMade = changesMade;
143: 		}
144: 
145: 		private boolean methodInsnQueued = false;
146: 
147: 		@Override public void visitMethodInsn(int opcode, String owner, String name, String desc, boolean itf) {
148: 			if (
149: 					opcode == Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC &&
150: 					"sneakyThrow".equals(name) &&
151: 					"lombok/Lombok".equals(owner) &&
152: 					"(Ljava/lang/Throwable;)Ljava/lang/RuntimeException;".equals(desc)) {
153: 
154: 				if (System.getProperty("lombok.debugAsmOnly", null) != null) {
155: 					super.visitMethodInsn(opcode, owner, name, desc, itf); // DEBUG for issue 470!
156: 				} else {
157: 					methodInsnQueued = true;
158: 				}
159: 			} else {
160: 				super.visitMethodInsn(opcode, owner, name, desc, itf);
161: 			}
162: 		}
163: 
164: 		private void handleQueue() {
165: 			if (!methodInsnQueued) return;
166: 			super.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "lombok/Lombok", "sneakyThrow", "(Ljava/lang/Throwable;)Ljava/lang/RuntimeException;", false);
167: 			methodInsnQueued = false;
168: 			diagnostics.addWarning("Proper usage is: throw lombok.Lombok.sneakyThrow(someException);. You did not 'throw' it. Because of this, the call to sneakyThrow " +
169: 					"remains in your classfile and you will need lombok.jar on the classpath at runtime.");
170: 		}
171: 
172: 		@Override public void visitInsn(int arg0) {
173: 			if (methodInsnQueued && arg0 == Opcodes.ATHROW) {
174: 				changesMade.set(true);

176: 				methodInsnQueued = false;
177: 			}
178: 			handleQueue();
179: 			super.visitInsn(arg0);
180: 		}
181: 		@Override public void visitFrame(int arg0, int arg1, Object[] arg2, int arg3, Object[] arg4) {
182: 			handleQueue();
183: 			super.visitFrame(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4);
184: 		}
185: 
186: 		@Override public void visitIincInsn(int arg0, int arg1) {
187: 			handleQueue();
188: 			super.visitIincInsn(arg0, arg1);
189: 		}
190: 
191: 		@Override public void visitFieldInsn(int arg0, String arg1, String arg2, String arg3) {
192: 			handleQueue();
193: 			super.visitFieldInsn(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3);
194: 		}
195: 
196: 		@Override public void visitIntInsn(int arg0, int arg1) {
197: 			handleQueue();
198: 			super.visitIntInsn(arg0, arg1);
199: 		}
200: 
201: 		@Override public void visitEnd() {
202: 			handleQueue();
203: 			super.visitEnd();
204: 		}
205: 
206: 		@Override public void visitInvokeDynamicInsn(String arg0, String arg1, Handle arg2, Object... arg3) {
207: 			handleQueue();
208: 			super.visitInvokeDynamicInsn(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3);
209: 		}
210: 
211: 		@Override public void visitLabel(Label arg0) {
212: 			handleQueue();
213: 			super.visitLabel(arg0);
214: 		}
215: 
216: 		@Override public void visitJumpInsn(int arg0, Label arg1) {
217: 			handleQueue();
218: 			super.visitJumpInsn(arg0, arg1);
219: 		}
220: 
221: 		@Override public void visitLdcInsn(Object arg0) {
222: 			handleQueue();
223: 			super.visitLdcInsn(arg0);
224: 		}
225: 
226: 		@Override public void visitLocalVariable(String arg0, String arg1, String arg2, Label arg3, Label arg4, int arg5) {
227: 			handleQueue();
228: 			super.visitLocalVariable(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5);
229: 		}

234: 		}

237: 			handleQueue();
238: 			super.visitLookupSwitchInsn(arg0, arg1, arg2);
